articles.title: US, Ukraine say Europe to join peace talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance
articles.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday, November 12, Europe would join the next round of talks with Russia, as Vladimir Putin indicated Moscow will not compromise on its hardline demands to end almost five years of war. In a packed day of shuttle diplomacy following negotiations in Abu Dhabi, Kushner and fellow envoy Steve Witkoff held over four hours of talks with Putin in the Kremlin before jetting to debrief Zelensky in Dublin.

He declared on November 11 that the country where he served as a missionary for about 20 years was his homeland.

articles.title: Microsoft faces a major Outlook outage: ‘no signs of a cyberattack’
articles.description: Microsoft said "malicious" activity was not to blame for an Outlook outage that left users around the world without its crucial services on Friday, November 13, but reported making headway in fixing the massive disruption. Businesses, governments and likely millions of individuals have been without services like Outlook email for over half a day, triggering wide-ranging consequences.

articles.title: France remembers victims of 2015 Paris terror attacks

articles.title: A Taïwan, les écarts de Jensen Huang suscitent davantage d’intérêt que les grandes manœuvres navales chinoises

articles.title: Lunettes connectées : la concurrence accrue devrait « pousser les fabricants à redoubler d’efforts en matière de respect de la vie privée »

There was a ban on "unregulated and illegal" gold mining in the area where the military was subsequently deployed. Security forces have expelled tens of thousands of foreign nationals who had come to work in the region's mines.

Contre ce phénomène qui s’étend, comme en témoigne la vigueur des attaques contre l’Etat de droit dans la campagne présidentielle française, les juges constitutionnels sont appelés à être en première ligne, explique le constitutionnaliste Julien Jeanneney.

articles.title: Quelles chances avez-vous réellement de gagner en achetant des jeux à gratter ? Et pour quel gain potentiel ?

articles.title: A la COP31, "103 grands groupes pollueurs" ont envoyé des délégations pour peser sur les négociations, dénoncent des ONG
